**SELECTED ACHIEVEMENTS**

**Payments platform migration:** At Solent Analytics, rebuilt a legacy batch settlement system as an event-driven service, taking ownership of the architecture, the data model, the API surface and observability. Checked the new pipeline against roughly 15 downstream consumers and laid the groundwork for real-time reconciliation and fraud detection, using trunk-based development and test-first practices to keep delivery fast.

**Multi-region routing architecture:** At Kestrel Logistics, designed a new event-driven routing layer for the parcel-tracking platform, solving a scalability bottleneck that cut p99 API latency from 900ms to roughly 150-200ms while keeping delivery-SLA guarantees intact and staying backward compatible with legacy carrier integrations — work that became the base for the broader kestrel-logistics.com platform.

**End-to-end platform engineering:** At Harrow Digital, carried a merchant onboarding product from its earliest sketches through to beta, shipping it across desktop and mobile, and picking up backend and infrastructure work along the way. Turned the CTO's product vision and the Design Lead's flows into a working release, checking in regularly with the COO to keep the launch on track.

**Shared services library:** At Fenwick & Vance, built a shared services library adopted across several internal platforms, retiring a set of duplicated legacy implementations in favour of one centrally-owned system. Went on to lead a follow-up services library for fenwickvance.com through to production.

**Ledger platform:** At Meridian Bank, came on as the second engineer on the project and carried an early prototype through to a live ledger-reconciliation platform serving roughly 40-80 internal analysts, putting the Go/Kafka architecture in place as the team scaled from 3 to about 20 people — a design a different department later picked up for its own platform.
